result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane urban street with wide sidewalks and signalized intersections. While pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps and signals are present, the wide roadway and lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings at the immediate foreground crossing increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The primary crossing area in the foreground lacks painted markings, reducing driver awareness of the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility of the pedestrian crossing zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to break up the crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban environment with a wide, unmarked intersection and a lack of formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the large expanse of asphalt and absence of crosswalk markings or signals increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Large Intersection Radius
hazards.description: The wide, open nature of the intersection allows for higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban roadway adjacent to a gas station with multiple driveways, creating frequent conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians. While sidewalks and street lighting are present, the lack of marked crosswalks at this intersection increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated or protected space.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: The gas station has wide, open curb cuts that allow vehicles to enter and exit across the sidewalk at various angles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the gas station entrance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian space and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the gas station driveways to reduce the area of conflict between cars and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or signals. While sidewalks are present, the large expanse of unmarked asphalt creates significant exposure and risk for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians with no designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway creates a very long exposure time for pedestrians without any refuge islands.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the foreground street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle signals exist, there are no visible pedestrian heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corners may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers synchronized with the traffic lights.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning strips and proper grading for wheelchair access at all crossing points.
